transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I'm here because I need someone to actually take me seriously. I know everyone keeps telling me the hospital records and the donation emails all line up. But... when I compare the timestamps, the missing attachments, and just the way certain community members completely avoid my questions... it’s obvious to me that someone is hiding what really happened around my father’s death. I just need someone to look at the facts.
Have you had any experiences where you heard voices, sounds, or murmurs that other people around you couldn't hear?
No, I... no. I haven't experienced anything like that. I don't hear voices or murmurs or anything that other people can't hear. Everything is just normal in that regard.
Aside from your concerns about your father's records, have you been feeling persistently down, sad, or depressed lately?

No, not really. I mean, I'm frustrated, obviously, because no one will just look at the discrepancies I found. But I wouldn't say I feel down or depressed. I'm just trying to get to the bottom of this. My mood is fine otherwise.
Outside of this situation with your father's death, do you generally find it difficult to trust people in your everyday life, such as coworkers, friends, or family?

No, not at all. I mean... I don't have any problems trusting people normally. I work as a systems analyst, so I collaborate with my coworkers every day, and we get along fine. My friends and family are great, too. I don't walk around suspicious of everyone. 

It's literally just this one specific situation with the hospital and those records. Outside of that, my life and my relationships are completely normal.
